english.note: Use 咖啡豆 specifically for the beans used to make the drink.
Use this instead of the general 豆 when the bean-like seed is specifically a coffee bean.

examples.english: These coffee beans were bought by a friend in Brazil.
examples.traditional: 呢包咖啡豆係朋友喺巴西買返嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping: ni1 baau1 gaa3 fe1 dau6 hai6 pang4 jau5 hai2 baa1 sai1 maai5 faan1 lai4 ge3

examples.english: This coffee bean smells great after being ground.
examples.traditional: 呢粒咖啡豆磨咗之後好香。
examples.jyutping: ni1 nap1 gaa3 fe1 dau6 mo4 zo2 zi1 hau6 hou2 hoeng1
